name: Alexandria
source:
Alex is immature and headstrong often diving headfirst into things based on emotions. She is compassionate at heart but that is undermined by her hatred for her enemies. She sees Angels as a source of Demons' suffering and up until she gets to know Aiden, she has no interest in peace.

[From [url=https://yoshibb.itch.io/divide]itch.io[/url]]
